About.title: Professional Biography
About.bio1: Senior full-stack developer with 9+ years architecting large-scale enterprise systems across fintech, logistics, and e-commerce. Specialized in distributed systems design, technical leadership, and scaling platforms to serve millions of concurrent users without sacrificing reliability.
About.bio2: Led engineering teams of up to 18 through complex migrations, from legacy monoliths to fully event-driven microservice ecosystems. Believes great architecture is judged by how boring production feels — no surprises, no fire drills, just consistent, measurable performance.
